hook: Drop a WhatsApp chat export, see who owes you what — one HTML file, nothing uploaded.
Paste plain text, get a printable Easy Read page: one idea per block, big type, a picture slot each.
Paste a WhatsApp order chat, get a clean order sheet, a baking/pick list and print-ready invoices — offline, one HTML file, nothing uploaded.
Drop a sliced .3mf/.gcode and get a print receipt: time, grams of filament, and cost, entirely offline.
Collapse a million log lines into a dozen templates — and diff a good run against a bad one. Offline, zero dependencies.
Full-screen signs, scoreboards, queue numbers, countdowns and timers where the URL is the app — send the link, send the sign.
